text: Current annual leave policy. Full-time employees receive 14 days annual leave per calendar year.
answer: Employees receive 14 days annual leave per calendar year.

text: Leave policy transition note. The 2026 refresh replaced the former 12 day entitlement with 14 days annual leave. This note summarises the change but is not the authoritative policy document.
answer: The current annual leave entitlement is 14 days per calendar year.

text: Archived annual leave policy. Before the 2026 refresh, employees received 12 days annual leave per calendar year.
answer: Employees received 12 days annual leave per calendar year under the archived 2024 policy.

text: Travel claims approval. Travel claims must be reviewed and approved by the employee's direct manager before reimbursement.
answer: Travel claims are approved by the direct manager.

text: Travel FAQ. For domestic travel, claims are still approved by the direct manager. This FAQ summarises the policy but is not the authoritative policy document.
answer: Domestic travel claims are approved by the direct manager.

text: Expense submission deadline. Employees must submit expense claims within 30 days of incurring the expense.
answer: Expense submissions are due within 30 days of incurring the expense.

text: Meal reimbursement limits. The maximum meal reimbursement is 50 dollars per day.
answer: The maximum meal reimbursement is 50 dollars per day.
